title: Development of a Cardano DApp and extensive documentation of each step along the way

ms.promise:
・Scope Document: A comprehensive outline detailing the project's goals, objectives, and deliverables.
・User Stories: A set of narratives capturing the needs and wants of the end-users.
・Use Cases and UML diagrams: Visual workflows depicting the DApp’s functional behaviour and structure. 
・Use Case Diagrams: These help in identifying the different actors (users, other systems, or DApps) and their interactions with the DApp. This can show how a user might initiate a transaction, query the blockchain, or interact with smart contracts.
・Class Diagrams: Useful for detailing the structure of smart contracts, including their attributes, operations, and the relationships between them. This could illustrate token standards (like ERC-20 or ERC-721), or more intricate contract relationships.
・Sequence Diagrams: These can depict the interactions over time between users, the DApp, external systems, and the underlying blockchain. This might show the sequence of calls to a smart contract function, how events are emitted, or how off-chain components interact with the blockchain.
・Activity Diagrams: These capture the dynamic behavior and flow within the system. They can be utilized to show the flow

List of challenge KPIs and how the project addressed them

・Educational Tool: This DApp can serve as an open-source and extensively documented exemplar, providing a comprehensive learning resource for individuals and entities interested in building on the Cardano blockchain.
・Operational DApp: Beyond its educational value, RAFFLEIZE C-A-R-D-A-N-A is intended to be a fully functioning DApp running on the Cardano mainnet, achieving the objectives like the ones listed below.

List of project KPIs and how the project addressed them

・Decentralized Trust: The commit and reveal scheme ensures that the process of picking a winner is transparent and verifiable, thus fostering trust among participants.
・Privacy Preservation & Inclusive Participation: By leveraging dynamic NFTs (using CIP-0068 Datum Metadata Standard) , Raffleize participation rights are tied to NFTs not to addresses.
・Enhanced Liquidity: Tokenizing raffle ownership and tickets makes these assets more liquid. Owners can easily trade or sell their stakes or participation rights on various platforms, not limited to the original DApp. 
・Recursive Raffle Opportunities: (Raffles of Raffles) Owners can create raffles for their raffle stakes or tickets, adding a recursive layer of engagement. This not only multiplies the opportunities for users to engage with the platform but also introduces a novel concept of raffle chains, where one can win a stake in another raffle, thereby increasing the excitement and engagement levels.
